newsitem.title: UK: INSTANT VIEW - UK July PSBR data.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW - UK July PSBR data.

text.p: Following is a selection of analysts' comment to July PSBR data. The figures showed a repayment of 3.875 billion pounds in the month. SHEETAL RADIA, MMS INTERNATIONAL "This figure is a lot better than we expected and the data highlights how strongly the economic cycle is affecting tax revenues and how strong the consumer sector is."

GERARD LYONS, DKB INTERNATIONAL: "The Chancellor at the time of the budget made a (PSBR forecast of) 10.9 billion stg and that implied further gilt sales of 16.5 billion.... It's quite possible we could get an undershoot of five to six billion pounds compared to that target.... We have a very favourable supply situation in the UK."

ANDREW MILLIGAN, GENERAL ACCIDENT: "The headline is an amazingly good figure. There would appear to be some special factors like tabacco duty and changes in VAT, but it certainly does tie in with the very strong state of the economy and it will provide very helpful support to the gilts market."

JEREMY HAWKINS, BANK OF AMERICA: "The UK PSDR was much larger than expected in July and suggests that the government will be able to meet this year's borrowing requirement without any real problems. This is clearly very positive from the supply side for gilts. However, the data reflect record VAT receipts and as such will be seen as increasing pressure on the Bank to hike rates again. This will keep the short end nervous and may give a slight lift to the pound."
